evidence_rule: Known means established only inside the cited evidence boundary. Model output is not hardware evidence.

I_known_known.statement: The selected Gen2.7 Fluxrelay point passed A6h on all 13 declared nonlinear-field bands at 380 A.
I_known_known.boundary: Three-mesh 2D nonlinear magnetostatic model; no transient 3D or hardware evidence.

I_known_known.statement: The selected Fluxrelay cage/circuit point passed all 29 A7c bands in all four declared robustness corners.
I_known_known.boundary: Homogenized cage plus sectional circuit/CG model.

I_known_known.statement: The controlling A7c hot reference shot is 893.412 J, leaving 6.588 J below the unchanged 900 J requirement.
I_known_known.boundary: Model margin only; supplier-backed hot resistance and switching losses remain open.

I_known_known.statement: A5e passed all 17 nominal CAD-fit bands for the exact selected Gen3 geometry.
I_known_known.boundary: Nominal solid geometry only; tolerance, thermal growth, vibration and runout remain open.

I_known_known.statement: A10 exposed the 12.0 m/s, 0.90 m and 8 g inconsistency; ADR-040 changed BOL-R-002 to 11.8 m/s.
I_known_known.boundary: Requirement correction, not a hardware result.

I_known_known.statement: A11 passed its eight executable ideal-gas/continuum leakage bands across the declared clearance and temperature grid.
I_known_known.boundary: No seal contact, friction, rarefaction, contamination, plume or valve transient evidence.

I_known_known.statement: A12 showed that the 121.36 g Fluxframe credit is material against sourced public 3U chassis masses, but awarded zero displaced-mass credit.
I_known_known.boundary: Public mass-envelope arithmetic; no selected bus or coupled structure/thermal/electrical proof.

II_unknown_known.question: Which rejected architectures were strong on one metric that now controls a different subsystem?
II_unknown_known.action: Search failed branches by metric, not architecture name, and route transferable principles through VOLLEY-lab.

II_unknown_known.question: Which launcher parts exist only because another launcher part exists?
II_unknown_known.action: Create a function-to-part dependency ledger before the next packaged-mass closure.

II_unknown_known.question: Which BOLLEY assumptions are inherited from VOLLEY rather than required by physics, safety or a provider?

II_unknown_known.action: Use them to open target-specific gates; never inherit their performance numbers.

flow: Quadrant IV becomes Quadrant III only after a source boundary and predeclared gate exist.
Quadrant III becomes Quadrant I after a run, measurement, supplier document or decision answers the stated question.
Quadrant II mining may create a new Quadrant III question without changing the controlled baseline.
A failed run still moves a question into Quadrant I because the failure and its boundary are knowledge.
